initialization: Exactly the earlier audit0.1s pole state and measured count/governor-velocity cart state. No reinitialization or coefficient fit.
method: Each recorded velocity interval has average acceleration delta(v)/delta(t). Linear interpolation of velocity preserves both interval endpoints; input at each1ms backend tick is [v(t+1ms)-v(t)]/1ms. Recorded acceleration comparison is unchanged linear interpolation at tick start.
caveats: Velocity is internal governor state, not independently measured physical cart velocity.
This is an offline reconstruction using interval endpoints, not a causal online velocity differentiator or a full firmware replay.
Velocities/counts/acceleration all originate in the same step generator; their agreement is internal consistency.
Per-frame optical comparisons use the fixed original-training pixel/count scale and proxy lag; metric scale, camera exposure time and motor force are unmeasured.
Camera support begins only when the reconstructed trajectory exists after initialization; missing raw geometry is never filled.
